title: Add D-pad flashlight aim offsets
objective: Add D-pad controls to examples/flashlight/run.py so the flashlight can be aimed around the camera in two angular axes with configurable min/max limits defaulting to +/-30 degrees.
instructions: Edit examples/flashlight/run.py only unless a directly necessary adjacent reference proves unavoidable.
Add D-pad input controls for two axes: left/right adjusts yaw offset, up/down adjusts pitch offset for the flashlight relative to the camera/pawn orientation.
Add CLI arguments to configure min and max angular limits; default to -30 and +30 degrees in both axes. Prefer clear argument names.
Add a sensible step size or rate control if needed, with a reasonable default, so holding or pressing D-pad moves predictably.
Reuse the existing safe FKey struct argument input polling pattern; do not reintroduce game.get_unreal_object(uclass='FKey').
Keep existing toggle key behavior, pose capture, Enter capture, and camera movement intact.
expected_outputs: Summary of new D-pad controls and CLI arguments.
definition_of_done: D-pad left/right and up/down move the flashlight aim around the camera in two axes.
Default angular bounds are +/-30 degrees in all directions.
